## R Shiny Graphic Basic
```{r}
# app.R
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(tidyr)

# --- Base parameters ---
Qos  <- 694444
Pos  <- 300
MCQo <- 6.5

# Recover original a, b from your system
A <- matrix(c(1, -Qos,
              1, -2*Qos), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
B <- c(Pos, MCQo)
sol <- solve(A, B)
a <- sol[1]; b <- sol[2]

# --- Solver function ---
solve_fringe <- function(n, ff, vv, g2, years2, a, b, MCQo) {
  m <- (a * (1 + g2)^years2 / b + n * ff / vv) / (1/b + n/vv)
  k <- 1 / (1/b + n/vv)

  QNNs <- (m - MCQo) / (2 * k)

  Po_QNN <- function(QNN) {
    numerator   <- a*(1 + g2)^years2 / b + n*ff / vv - QNN
    denominator <- 1/b + n/vv
    numerator / denominator
  }
  Pos_2 <- Po_QNN(QNNs)

  Sf_total <- max(n * ((Pos_2 - ff) / vv), 0)
  Sf_per_firm <- ifelse(n > 0, Sf_total / n, 0)
  Q_total <- QNNs + Sf_total

  data.frame(
    n = n,
    QNNs = QNNs,
    Pos_2 = Pos_2,
    Sf_total = Sf_total,
    Sf_per_firm = Sf_per_firm,
    Q_total = Q_total
  )
}

# --- UI ---
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("t=2: Competitive Fringe Generics with Dominant Novo Nordisk; Scenario Analysis"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput("ff", "Generics Marginal Cost (Constant Portion):",
                  min = 5.5, max = 7.5, value = 6.5, step = 0.1),
      sliderInput("vv", "Generic Marginal Cost (Varying Portion):",
                  min = 0.000001, max = 0.1, value = 0.001, step = 0.0005),
      sliderInput("g2", "Yearly Growth Rate (Y-o-Y%):",
                  min = 0.0, max = 0.2, value = 0.1, step = 0.01),
      sliderInput("years2", "Time Horizon",
                  min = 0, max = 20, value = 8, step = 1)
    ),
    mainPanel(
      fluidRow(
        column(6, plotOutput("pricePlot")),
        column(6, plotOutput("quantityPlot"))
      )
    )
  )
)

# --- Server ---
server <- function(input, output) {
  results <- reactive({
    n_grid <- 2:20
    lapply(n_grid, function(n) {
      solve_fringe(n, input$ff, input$vv, input$g2, input$years2, a, b, MCQo)
    }) %>% bind_rows()
  })

  output$pricePlot <- renderPlot({
    df <- results()
    ggplot(df, aes(x = n, y = Pos_2)) +
      geom_line(aes(color = "Equilibrium Price"), size = 1.2) +
      geom_point(aes(color = "Equilibrium Price"), size = 2) +
      geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 300, linetype = "Original Monopoly Price")) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Equilibrium Price" = "red")) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Original Monopoly Price" = "dashed")) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +
      labs(title = "Equilibrium Price vs. Number of Generic Drug Producers",
           x = "Number of Generic Drug Producers (n)",
           y = "Equilibrium Price (P*)",
           color = NULL,
           linetype = NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(legend.position = "top")
  })

  output$quantityPlot <- renderPlot({
    df <- results() %>%
      select(n, QNNs, Sf_total, Q_total) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(QNNs, Sf_total, Q_total),
                   names_to = "Quantity_Type", values_to = "Quantity")

    ggplot(df, aes(x = n, y = Quantity, color = Quantity_Type)) +
      geom_line(size = 1.2) +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("QNNs" = "red",
                                    "Sf_total" = "blue",
                                    "Q_total" = "darkgreen"),
                         labels = c("Total Market Output",
                                    "Novo Nordisk Output",
                                    "Total Generics Output")) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
      labs(title = "Output vs. Number of Generic Drug Producers",
           x = "Number of Generic Drug Producers (n)",
           y = "Quantity of Ozempic + Biosimilars (Q*)",
           color = NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(legend.position = "top")
  })
}

# --- Run the app ---
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```






```{r}
# app.R
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)

# --- Base parameters ---
Qos  <- 694444
Pos  <- 300
MCQo <- 6.5

# Recovering original a, b from my system
A <- matrix(c(1, -Qos,
              1, -2*Qos), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
B <- c(Pos, MCQo)
sol <- solve(A, B)
a <- sol[1]; b <- sol[2]

# --- Solver function ---
solve_fringe <- function(n, ff, vv, g2, years2, a, b, MCQo) {
  m <- (a * (1 + g2)^years2 / b + n * ff / vv) / (1/b + n/vv)
  k <- 1 / (1/b + n/vv)

  QNNs <- (m - MCQo) / (2 * k)

  Po_QNN <- function(QNN) {
    numerator   <- a*(1 + g2)^years2 / b + n*ff / vv - QNN
    denominator <- 1/b + n/vv
    numerator / denominator
  }
  Pos_2 <- Po_QNN(QNNs)

  Sf_total <- max(n * ((Pos_2 - ff) / vv), 0)
  Sf_per_firm <- ifelse(n > 0, Sf_total / n, 0)
  Q_total <- QNNs + Sf_total

  data.frame(
    n = n,
    QNNs = QNNs,
    Pos_2 = Pos_2,
    Sf_total = Sf_total,
    Sf_per_firm = Sf_per_firm,
    Q_total = Q_total
  )
}

# --- UI ---
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("t=2: Competitive Fringe Generics with Dominant Novo Nordisk; Scenario Analysis"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput("ff", HTML("Generics Marginal Cost (Constant Portion)"),
                  min = 5.5, max = 7.5, value = 6.5, step = 0.1),
      sliderInput("vv", HTML("Generic Marginal Cost (Varying Portion)"),
                  min = 0.000001, max = 0.005, value = 0.001, step = 0.00005),
      sliderInput("g2", HTML("Yearly Growth Rate (Y-o-Y%)"),
                  min = 0.0, max = 0.2, value = 0.1, step = 0.01),
      sliderInput("years2", HTML("Time Horizon (Years)"),
                  min = 0, max = 12, value = 8, step = 1),
      actionButton("reset", "Reset to Base Case")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      fluidRow(
        column(6, plotlyOutput("pricePlot")),
        column(6, plotlyOutput("quantityPlot"))
      )
    )
  )
)

# --- Server ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Reset button observer
  observeEvent(input$reset, {
    updateSliderInput(session, "ff", value = 6.5)
    updateSliderInput(session, "vv", value = 0.001)
    updateSliderInput(session, "g2", value = 0.1)
    updateSliderInput(session, "years2", value = 8)
  })

  results <- reactive({
    n_grid <- 2:20
    df <- lapply(n_grid, function(n) {
      solve_fringe(n, input$ff, input$vv, input$g2, input$years2, a, b, MCQo)
    }) %>% bind_rows()

    # Calculate percentage changes
    df <- df %>%
      arrange(n) %>%
      mutate(
        pct_change_price = (Pos_2 - lag(Pos_2)) / lag(Pos_2) * 100,
        pct_change_QNNs = (QNNs - lag(QNNs)) / lag(QNNs) * 100,
        pct_change_Sf_total = (Sf_total - lag(Sf_total)) / lag(Sf_total) * 100,
        pct_change_Q_total = (Q_total - lag(Q_total)) / lag(Q_total) * 100,
        pct_change_from300 = (Pos_2 - 300) / 300 * 100
      )
    df
  })

  output$pricePlot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- results()
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = n, y = Pos_2)) +
      geom_line(aes(color = "Equilibrium Price"), size = 0.6) +
      geom_point(aes(color = "Equilibrium Price",
                     text = paste0("n: ", n,
                                   "<br>P*: ", dollar(Pos_2, accuracy = 0.01),
                                   "<br>% change from n-1: ",
                                   ifelse(is.na(pct_change_price), "NA",
                                          paste0(round(pct_change_price, 2), "%")),
                                   "<br>% change from P*=300: ",
                                   paste0(round(pct_change_from300, 2), "%"))),
                 size = 1.2) +
      geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 300, linetype = "Original Monopoly Price")) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Equilibrium Price" = "red")) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Original Monopoly Price" = "dashed")) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 20, 2)) +
      labs(title = "Equilibrium Price vs. Number of Generic Drug Producers",
           x = "Number of Generic Drug Producers (n)",
           y = "Equilibrium Price (P*)",
           color = NULL,
           linetype = NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2)
      )

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
      layout(
        legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.35, font = list(size = 9)),
        margin = list(b = 80)
      ) %>%
      config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
  })

output$quantityPlot <- renderPlotly({
  df <- results() %>%
    # compute both shares before pivot
    mutate(
      generic_share = ifelse(Q_total > 0, Sf_total / Q_total * 100, NA),
      novo_share    = ifelse(Q_total > 0, QNNs / Q_total * 100, NA)
    ) %>%
    select(n, QNNs, Sf_total, Q_total,
           pct_change_QNNs, pct_change_Sf_total, pct_change_Q_total,
           generic_share, novo_share) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(QNNs, Sf_total, Q_total),
                 names_to = "Quantity_Type", values_to = "Quantity") %>%
    mutate(
      pct_change = case_when(
        Quantity_Type == "QNNs" ~ pct_change_QNNs,
        Quantity_Type == "Sf_total" ~ pct_change_Sf_total,
        Quantity_Type == "Q_total" ~ pct_change_Q_total
      ),
      label = case_when(
        Quantity_Type == "QNNs" ~ "Novo Nordisk Output",
        Quantity_Type == "Sf_total" ~ "Total Generics Output",
        Quantity_Type == "Q_total" ~ "Total Market Output"
      )
    )

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = n, y = Quantity, color = label)) +
    geom_line(size = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(text = paste0(
      "n: ", n,
      "<br>", label, " : ", comma(round(Quantity, 0)),
      "<br>% change from n-1: ",
      ifelse(is.na(pct_change), "NA",
             paste0(round(pct_change, 2), "%")),
      ifelse(label == "Total Generics Output",
             paste0("<br>Generic Market Share: ",
                    ifelse(is.na(generic_share), "NA",
                           paste0(round(generic_share, 2), "%"))),
             ifelse(label == "Novo Nordisk Output",
                    paste0("<br>Novo Nordisk Market Share: ",
                           ifelse(is.na(novo_share), "NA",
                                  paste0(round(novo_share, 2), "%"))),
                    ""))  # nothing extra for Total Market Output
    )),
    size = 1.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Novo Nordisk Output" = "red",
                                  "Total Generics Output" = "blue",
                                  "Total Market Output" = "darkgreen")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 20, 2)) +
    labs(title = "Equilibrium Output vs. Number of Generic Drug Producers",
         x = "Number of Generic Drug Producers (n)",
         y = "Quantity of Ozempic + Biosimilars (Q*)",
         color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2)
    )

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
    layout(
      legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.35, font = list(size = 9)),
      margin = list(b = 80)
    ) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
})
}

# --- Run the app ---
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```








## R Shiny Graphic with Government Intervention 
```{r}
# app.R
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)

# --- Base parameters ---
Qos  <- 694444
Pos  <- 300
MCQo <- 6.5

# Recovering original a, b from system
A <- matrix(c(1, -Qos,
              1, -2*Qos), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
B <- c(Pos, MCQo)
sol <- solve(A, B)
a <- sol[1]; b <- sol[2]

# --- Solver function ---
solve_fringe <- function(n, ff, vv, g2, years2, a, b, MCQo, pc_on, pc) {
  
  # Unconstrained equilibrium (your original logic)
  m <- (a * (1 + g2)^years2 / b + n * ff / vv) / (1/b + n/vv)
  k <- 1 / (1/b + n/vv)
  QNNs_uncon <- (m - MCQo) / (2 * k)
  Po_QNN <- function(QNN) {
    numerator   <- a*(1 + g2)^years2 / b + n*ff / vv - QNN
    denominator <- 1/b + n/vv
    numerator / denominator
  }
  Pos_uncon <- Po_QNN(QNNs_uncon)
  Sf_total_uncon <- max(n * ((Pos_uncon - ff) / vv), 0)
  Q_total_uncon <- QNNs_uncon + Sf_total_uncon
  
  # If ceiling is OFF, return unconstrained results
  if (!pc_on) {
    return(data.frame(
      n = n,
      QNNs = QNNs_uncon,
      Pos_2 = Pos_uncon,
      Sf_total = Sf_total_uncon,
      Sf_per_firm = ifelse(n > 0, Sf_total_uncon / n, 0),
      Q_total = Q_total_uncon
    ))
  }
  
  # If ceiling is ON
  if (Pos_uncon <= pc) {
    # Ceiling not binding → same as unconstrained
    return(data.frame(
      n = n,
      QNNs = QNNs_uncon,
      Pos_2 = Pos_uncon,
      Sf_total = Sf_total_uncon,
      Sf_per_firm = ifelse(n > 0, Sf_total_uncon / n, 0),
      Q_total = Q_total_uncon
    ))
  } else {
    # Ceiling binds
    # Generics supply at ceiling
    Sf_total <- n * ((pc - ff) / vv)
    
    # Residual demand for Novo: P = a*(1+g2)^years2 - b*(QNN + Sf_total)
    # Solve Cournot best response for Novo
    m_resid <- (a * (1 + g2)^years2 / b - Sf_total) / (1/b)
    k_resid <- 1 / (1/b)
    QNNs <- (m_resid - MCQo) / (2 * k_resid)
    Pos_new <- a*(1 + g2)^years2 - b*(QNNs + Sf_total)
    
    # If Novo’s price falls below ceiling, generics follow Novo’s price
    if (Pos_new < pc) {
      Sf_total <- max(n * ((Pos_new - ff) / vv), 0)
      Pos_new <- a*(1 + g2)^years2 - b*(QNNs + Sf_total)
    }
    
    Q_total <- QNNs + Sf_total
    
    return(data.frame(
      n = n,
      QNNs = QNNs,
      Pos_2 = Pos_new,
      Sf_total = Sf_total,
      Sf_per_firm = ifelse(n > 0, Sf_total / n, 0),
      Q_total = Q_total
    ))
  }
}

# --- UI ---
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("t=2: Competitive Fringe Generics with Dominant Novo Nordisk; Scenario Analysis"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput("ff", HTML("Generics Marginal Cost (Constant Portion)"),
                  min = 3.5, max = 7.5, value = 6.5, step = 0.1),
      sliderInput("vv", HTML("Generic Marginal Cost (Varying Portion)"),
                  min = 0.000001, max = 0.005, value = 0.001, step = 0.00005),
      sliderInput("g2", HTML("Yearly Growth Rate (Y-o-Y%)"),
                  min = 0.0, max = 0.2, value = 0.1, step = 0.01),
      sliderInput("years2", HTML("Time Horizon (Years)"),
                  min = 0, max = 12, value = 8, step = 1),
      checkboxInput("pc_on", "Enable Generic Price Ceiling", value = FALSE),
      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.pc_on == true",
        sliderInput("pc", "Generic Price Ceiling ($)",
                    min = 10, max = 200, value = 100, step = 10)
      ),
      actionButton("reset", "Reset to Base Case")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      fluidRow(
        column(6, plotlyOutput("pricePlot")),
        column(6, plotlyOutput("quantityPlot"))
      )
    )
  )
)

# --- Server ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Reset button observer
  observeEvent(input$reset, {
    updateSliderInput(session, "ff", value = 6.5)
    updateSliderInput(session, "vv", value = 0.001)
    updateSliderInput(session, "g2", value = 0.1)
    updateSliderInput(session, "years2", value = 8)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "pc_on", value = FALSE)
    updateSliderInput(session, "pc", value = 100)
  })
  
  results <- reactive({
    n_grid <- 2:20
    df <- lapply(n_grid, function(n) {
      solve_fringe(n, input$ff, input$vv, input$g2, input$years2, a, b, MCQo,
                   input$pc_on, input$pc)
    }) %>% bind_rows()
    
    # Calculate percentage changes
    df <- df %>%
      arrange(n) %>%
      mutate(
        pct_change_price = (Pos_2 - lag(Pos_2)) / lag(Pos_2) * 100,
        pct_change_QNNs = (QNNs - lag(QNNs)) / lag(QNNs) * 100,
        pct_change_Sf_total = (Sf_total - lag(Sf_total)) / lag(Sf_total) * 100,
        pct_change_Q_total = (Q_total - lag(Q_total)) / lag(Q_total) * 100,
        pct_change_from300 = (Pos_2 - 300) / 300 * 100
      )
    df
  })
  
   output$pricePlot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- results()
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = n, y = Pos_2)) +
      geom_line(aes(color = "Equilibrium Price"), size = 0.6) +
      geom_point(aes(color = "Equilibrium Price",
                     text = paste0("n: ", n,
                                   "<br>P*: ", dollar(Pos_2, accuracy = 0.01),
                                   "<br>% change from n-1: ",
                                   ifelse(is.na(pct_change_price), "NA",
                                          paste0(round(pct_change_price, 2), "%")),
                                   "<br>% change from P*=300: ",
                                   paste0(round(pct_change_from300, 2), "%"))),
                 size = 1.2) +
      geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 300, linetype = "Original Monopoly Price")) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Equilibrium Price" = "red")) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Original Monopoly Price" = "dashed")) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 20, 2)) +
      labs(title = "Equilibrium Price vs. Number of Generic Drug Producers",
           x = "Number of Generic Drug Producers (n)",
           y = "Equilibrium Price (P*)",
           color = NULL,
           linetype = NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2)
      )
    
    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
      layout(
        legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.35, font = list(size = 9)),
        margin = list(b = 80)
      ) %>%
      config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
  })
  
  output$quantityPlot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- results() %>%
      # compute both shares before pivot
      mutate(
        generic_share = ifelse(Q_total > 0, Sf_total / Q_total * 100, NA),
        novo_share    = ifelse(Q_total > 0, QNNs / Q_total * 100, NA)
      ) %>%
      select(n, QNNs, Sf_total, Q_total,
             pct_change_QNNs, pct_change_Sf_total, pct_change_Q_total,
             generic_share, novo_share) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(QNNs, Sf_total, Q_total),
                   names_to = "Quantity_Type", values_to = "Quantity") %>%
      mutate(
        pct_change = case_when(
          Quantity_Type == "QNNs" ~ pct_change_QNNs,
          Quantity_Type == "Sf_total" ~ pct_change_Sf_total,
          Quantity_Type == "Q_total" ~ pct_change_Q_total
        ),
        label = case_when(
          Quantity_Type == "QNNs" ~ "Novo Nordisk Output",
          Quantity_Type == "Sf_total" ~ "Total Generics Output",
          Quantity_Type == "Q_total" ~ "Total Market Output"
        )
      )
    
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = n, y = Quantity, color = label)) +
      geom_line(size = 0.6) +
      geom_point(aes(text = paste0(
        "n: ", n,
        "<br>", label, " : ", comma(round(Quantity, 0)),
        "<br>% change from n-1: ",
        ifelse(is.na(pct_change), "NA",
               paste0(round(pct_change, 2), "%")),
        ifelse(label == "Total Generics Output",
               paste0("<br>Generic Market Share: ",
                      ifelse(is.na(generic_share), "NA",
                             paste0(round(generic_share, 2), "%"))),
               ifelse(label == "Novo Nordisk Output",
                      paste0("<br>Novo Nordisk Market Share: ",
                             ifelse(is.na(novo_share), "NA",
                                    paste0(round(novo_share, 2), "%"))),
                      ""))  # nothing extra for Total Market Output
      )),
      size = 1.2) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Novo Nordisk Output" = "red",
                                    "Total Generics Output" = "blue",
                                    "Total Market Output" = "darkgreen")) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 20, 2)) +
      labs(title = "Equilibrium Output vs. Number of Generic Drug Producers",
           x = "Number of Generic Drug Producers (n)",
           y = "Quantity of Ozempic + Biosimilars (Q*)",
           color = NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2)
      )
    
    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
      layout(
        legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.35, font = list(size = 9)),
        margin = list(b = 80)
      ) %>%
      config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
  })
}

# --- Run the app ---
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

## R Shiny Graphic with Government Intervention + Visuals 
```{r}
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)
library(patchwork)

# --- Base parameters ---
Qos  <- 694444
Pos  <- 300
MCQo <- 6.5

# Recovering original a, b from system
A <- matrix(c(1, -Qos,
              1, -2*Qos), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
B <- c(Pos, MCQo)
sol <- solve(A, B)
a <- sol[1]; b <- sol[2]

# --- Solver function for top plots ---
solve_fringe <- function(n, ff, vv, g2, years2, a, b, MCQo, pc_on, pc) {
  m <- (a * (1 + g2)^years2 / b + n * ff / vv) / (1/b + n/vv)
  k <- 1 / (1/b + n/vv)
  QNNs_uncon <- (m - MCQo) / (2 * k)
  Po_QNN <- function(QNN) {
    numerator   <- a*(1 + g2)^years2 / b + n*ff / vv - QNN
    denominator <- 1/b + n/vv
    numerator / denominator
  }
  Pos_uncon <- Po_QNN(QNNs_uncon)
  Sf_total_uncon <- max(n * ((Pos_uncon - ff) / vv), 0)
  Q_total_uncon <- QNNs_uncon + Sf_total_uncon
  
  if (!pc_on) {
    return(data.frame(
      n = n, QNNs = QNNs_uncon, Pos_2 = Pos_uncon,
      Sf_total = Sf_total_uncon, Sf_per_firm = ifelse(n > 0, Sf_total_uncon / n, 0),
      Q_total = Q_total_uncon
    ))
  }
  
  if (Pos_uncon <= pc) {
    return(data.frame(
      n = n, QNNs = QNNs_uncon, Pos_2 = Pos_uncon,
      Sf_total = Sf_total_uncon, Sf_per_firm = ifelse(n > 0, Sf_total_uncon / n, 0),
      Q_total = Q_total_uncon
    ))
  } else {
    Sf_total <- n * ((pc - ff) / vv)
    m_resid <- (a * (1 + g2)^years2 / b - Sf_total) / (1/b)
    k_resid <- 1 / (1/b)
    QNNs <- (m_resid - MCQo) / (2 * k_resid)
    Pos_new <- a*(1 + g2)^years2 - b*(QNNs + Sf_total)
    if (Pos_new < pc) {
      Sf_total <- max(n * ((Pos_new - ff) / vv), 0)
      Pos_new <- a*(1 + g2)^years2 - b*(QNNs + Sf_total)
    }
    Q_total <- QNNs + Sf_total
    return(data.frame(
      n = n, QNNs = QNNs, Pos_2 = Pos_new,
      Sf_total = Sf_total, Sf_per_firm = ifelse(n > 0, Sf_total / n, 0),
      Q_total = Q_total
    ))
  }
}

# --- UI ---
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("t=2: Long-run Equilibrium Scenario Analysis; Competitive Fringe Generics with Dominant Novo Nordisk"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput("ff", HTML("Generics Marginal Cost (Constant Portion)"),
                  min = 3.5, max = 7.5, value = 6.5, step = 0.1),
      sliderInput("vv", HTML("Generic Marginal Cost (Varying Portion)"),
                  min = 0.000001, max = 0.005, value = 0.001, step = 0.00005),
      sliderInput("g2", HTML("Yearly Growth Rate (Y-o-Y%)"),
                  min = 0.0, max = 0.2, value = 0.1, step = 0.01),
      sliderInput("years2", HTML("Time Horizon (Years)"),
                  min = 0, max = 12, value = 8, step = 1),
      checkboxInput("pc_on", "Enable Generic Price Ceiling", value = FALSE),
      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.pc_on == true",
        sliderInput("pc", "Generic Price Ceiling ($)",
                    min = 10, max = 200, value = 100, step = 10)
      ),
      actionButton("reset", "Reset to Base Case"),
      hr(style = "border-top: 3px solid #444; margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px;"),
      h4("Additional Control for Lower Plots Only"),
      sliderInput("n_new", "Number of Generic Drug Producers (n)",
                  min = 2, max = 20, value = 8, step = 1)
    ),
    mainPanel(
      fluidRow(
        column(6, plotlyOutput("pricePlot")),
        column(6, plotlyOutput("quantityPlot"))
      ),
      hr(),
      fluidRow(
        column(12, plotOutput("fringePlots"))
      )
    )
  )
)

# --- Server ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observeEvent(input$reset, {
    updateSliderInput(session, "ff", value = 6.5)
    updateSliderInput(session, "vv", value = 0.001)
    updateSliderInput(session, "g2", value = 0.1)
    updateSliderInput(session, "years2", value = 8)
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "pc_on", value = FALSE)
    updateSliderInput(session, "pc", value = 100)
  })
  
  results <- reactive({
    n_grid <- 2:20
    df <- lapply(n_grid, function(n) {
      solve_fringe(n, input$ff, input$vv, input$g2, input$years2, a, b, MCQo,
                   input$pc_on, input$pc)
    }) %>% bind_rows()
    df <- df %>%
      arrange(n) %>%
      mutate(
        pct_change_price = (Pos_2 - lag(Pos_2)) / lag(Pos_2) * 100,
        pct_change_QNNs = (QNNs - lag(QNNs)) / lag(QNNs) * 100,
        pct_change_Sf_total = (Sf_total - lag(Sf_total)) / lag(Sf_total) * 100,
        pct_change_Q_total = (Q_total - lag(Q_total)) / lag(Q_total) * 100,
        pct_change_from300 = (Pos_2 - 300) / 300 * 100
      )
    df
  })
  
  output$pricePlot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- results()
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = n, y = Pos_2)) +
      geom_line(aes(color = "Equilibrium Price"), size = 0.6, show.legend = TRUE) +
      geom_point(aes(color = "Equilibrium Price",
                     text = paste0(
                       "n: ", n,
                       "<br>P*: ", dollar(Pos_2, accuracy = 0.01),
                       "<br>% change from n-1: ",
                       ifelse(is.na(pct_change_price), "NA", paste0(round(pct_change_price, 2), "%")),
                       "<br>% change from P*=300: ", paste0(round(pct_change_from300, 2), "%")
                     )),
                 size = 1.2,
                 show.legend = FALSE
                 ) +
      geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 300, linetype = "Original Monopoly Price")) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Equilibrium Price" = "red")) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Original Monopoly Price" = "dashed")) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 20, 2)) +
      labs(title = "Equilibrium Price vs. Number of Generic Drug Producers",
           x = "Number of Generic Drug Producers (n)",
           y = "Equilibrium Price (P*)",
           color = NULL,
           linetype = NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2)
      )
    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
      layout(
        legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.35, font = list(size = 9)),
        margin = list(b = 80)
      ) %>%
      config(displayModeBar = FALSE) %>%
  plotly::style(name = "Equilibrium Price", traces = 1) %>%
  plotly::style(name = "Original Monopoly Price", traces = 3)
  })

  output$quantityPlot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- results() %>%
      mutate(
        generic_share = ifelse(Q_total > 0, Sf_total / Q_total * 100, NA),
        novo_share    = ifelse(Q_total > 0, QNNs / Q_total * 100, NA)
      ) %>%
      select(n, QNNs, Sf_total, Q_total,
             pct_change_QNNs, pct_change_Sf_total, pct_change_Q_total,
             generic_share, novo_share) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(QNNs, Sf_total, Q_total),
        names_to = "Quantity_Type",
        values_to = "Quantity"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        pct_change = case_when(
          Quantity_Type == "QNNs" ~ pct_change_QNNs,
          Quantity_Type == "Sf_total" ~ pct_change_Sf_total,
          Quantity_Type == "Q_total" ~ pct_change_Q_total
        ),
        label = case_when(
          Quantity_Type == "QNNs" ~ "Novo Nordisk Output",
          Quantity_Type == "Sf_total" ~ "Total Generics Output",
          Quantity_Type == "Q_total" ~ "Total Market Output"
        )
      )

    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = n, y = Quantity, color = label)) +
      geom_line(size = 0.6) +
      geom_point(aes(text = paste0(
        "n: ", n,
        "<br>", label, " : ", comma(round(Quantity, 0)),
        "<br>% change from n-1: ",
        ifelse(is.na(pct_change), "NA", paste0(round(pct_change, 2), "%")),
        ifelse(label == "Total Generics Output",
               paste0("<br>Generic Market Share: ",
                      ifelse(is.na(generic_share), "NA", paste0(round(generic_share, 2), "%"))),
               ifelse(label == "Novo Nordisk Output",
                      paste0("<br>Novo Nordisk Market Share: ",
                             ifelse(is.na(novo_share), "NA", paste0(round(novo_share, 2), "%"))),
                      ""))
      )), size = 1.2) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(
        "Novo Nordisk Output" = "red",
        "Total Generics Output" = "blue",
        "Total Market Output"   = "darkgreen"
      )) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 20, 2)) +
      labs(title = "Equilibrium Output vs. Number of Generic Drug Producers",
           x = "Number of Generic Drug Producers (n)",
           y = "Quantity of Ozempic + Biosimilars (Q*)",
           color = NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.2)
      )

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
      layout(
        legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.35, font = list(size = 9)),
        margin = list(b = 80)
      ) %>%
      config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
  })

   # --- Lower comparative-fringe plots ---
  output$fringePlots <- renderPlot({
    ff   <- input$ff
    vv   <- input$vv
    n    <- input$n_new
    g2   <- input$g2
    yrs  <- input$years2
    pc_on <- input$pc_on
    pc    <- input$pc

    Demand_full <- function(Q) a * (1 + g2)^yrs - b * Q

    # Default residual demand/MR
    m <- (a * (1 + g2)^yrs / b + n * ff / vv) / (1/b + n/vv)
    k <- 1 / (1/b + n/vv)
    Demand_resid <- function(Q) m - k * Q
    MR_resid     <- function(Q) m - 2 * k * Q

    # Unconstrained equilibrium
    Q_dom_uncon <- (m - MCQo) / (2 * k)
    P_eq_uncon  <- Demand_resid(Q_dom_uncon)
    Q_fringe_uncon <- max(n * ((P_eq_uncon - ff) / vv), 0)

    # Adjust if ceiling binds
    if (!pc_on) {
      Q_dom <- Q_dom_uncon; P_eq <- P_eq_uncon; Q_fringe <- Q_fringe_uncon
    } else if (P_eq_uncon <= pc) {
      Q_dom <- Q_dom_uncon; P_eq <- P_eq_uncon; Q_fringe <- Q_fringe_uncon
    } else {
      Sf_total <- n * ((pc - ff) / vv)
      m_resid <- (a * (1 + g2)^yrs / b - Sf_total) / (1/b)
      k_resid <- 1 / (1/b)
      Q_dom <- (m_resid - MCQo) / (2 * k_resid)
      P_eq  <- a * (1 + g2)^yrs - b * (Q_dom + Sf_total)
      if (P_eq < pc) {
        Sf_total <- max(n * ((P_eq - ff) / vv), 0)
        P_eq  <- a * (1 + g2)^yrs - b * (Q_dom + Sf_total)
      }
      Q_fringe <- Sf_total
      # Update residual demand/MR functions for plotting
      Demand_resid <- function(Q) a * (1 + g2)^yrs - b * (Q + Sf_total)
      MR_resid     <- function(Q) a * (1 + g2)^yrs - b * Sf_total - 2 * b * Q
    }

    Q_seq <- seq(0, 2500000, length.out = 400)
    P_seq <- seq(0, max(Pos, P_eq * 1.5), length.out = 400)

    df_left_demand <- tibble(Q = Q_seq, P = Demand_full(Q_seq))
    df_left_supply <- tibble(
  Q = Q_seq,
  P = ff + vv * (Q_seq / n)   # invert supply function to express P as function of Q
)
    df_left_MC_ind <- tibble(
      q = seq(0, max(Q_fringe / n) * 1.5, length.out = 200),
      P = ff + vv * seq(0, max(Q_fringe / n) * 1.5, length.out = 200)
    )

    df_right <- tibble(
      Q = Q_seq,
      Demand_full = Demand_full(Q_seq),
      Demand_resid = Demand_resid(Q_seq),
      MR = MR_resid(Q_seq),
      MC = MCQo
    )

    P_max <- max(df_left_demand$P, df_right$Demand_full, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05

        plot_left <- ggplot() +
      geom_line(data = df_left_demand, aes(x = Q, y = P), color = "lightsalmon", size = 1.2) +
      geom_line(data = df_left_supply, aes(x = Q, y = P), color = "blue", size = 1.2) +
      geom_line(data = df_left_MC_ind, aes(x = q, y = P), color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = P_eq, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = Q_fringe, linetype = "dotted", color = "blue") +
      { if (pc_on) geom_hline(yintercept = pc, color = "black", size = 0.8) } +
      scale_x_continuous(labels = comma, expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 2500000),
                         breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, P_max),
                         breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
      labs(x = expression(paste("Quantity of Generics (",Q[f],")")
                          ), y = "Market Price (CAD)",
           title = "Generic Drugs (Competitive Fringe)") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
      )

    plot_right <- ggplot(df_right, aes(x = Q)) +
      geom_line(aes(y = Demand_full), color = "lightsalmon", size = 1.2) +
      geom_line(aes(y = Demand_resid), color = "red", size = 1.2) +
      geom_line(aes(y = MR), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
      geom_line(aes(y = MC), color = "darkgreen", size = 1.2) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = Q_dom, linetype = "dotted", color = "red") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = P_eq, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
      scale_x_continuous(labels = comma, expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 2500000),
                         breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, P_max),
                         breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
      labs(x = expression(paste("Quantity of Brand Ozempic (", Q[O], ")")
), y = "Market Price (CAD)",
           title = "Novo Nordisk (Dominant Firm)") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
      )

    # Combine side-by-side
    plot_left + plot_right
  })
}

# --- Run the app ---
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
